title: Courier or delivery claim
summary: A delivery message asks for a small payment, address update, or login.
scenario: The message uses a parcel explanation to send you to an unexpected payment or login page.
warning_signs: You are not expecting a parcel
A small fee is required to release delivery
The link or sender does not match your order records
safe_actions: Check orders in the merchant or courier app you already use
Do not enter credentials through the message link
recovery_guidance: Change credentials if entered into an untrusted page
Contact the payment provider for any payment concern
reporting_guidance: Keep the tracking claim and link as evidence without opening it again
prevention_tips: Use order history rather than incoming delivery links
Inspect the final domain before signing in
false_positive_notes: Real delivery notices exist; an unexpected fee or mismatched order still deserves independent verification.
